entities.name: St. Peter the Apostle Cathedral, La Guaira
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Peter the Apostle Cathedral also simply called Cathedral of St. Peter or alternatively Cathedral of La Guaira is a religious building belonging to the Catholic Church and is located in the city of La Guaira, Capital of the Vargas State in the South American country of Venezuela. It is a national historic monument declared as such in 1960 by the Official Gazette number 26,320. In 1969 the colonial surrounding area was also protected.
